source.note: ミラーでこの3つが3すくみになっていることが知られている、という報告。原文の記法は「①←②←③←①」。矢印の向きは原文からは一意に決まらないので、ツールは向きを仮定せず測った向きを表示する

note: This is *human* knowledge, not a model output, which is why it is worth keeping: the mirror is the one case where the game's value is forced to 0.500 by the value function's antisymmetry, so a cycle here is a claim the model can be checked against rather than a claim derived from it. A pure equilibrium in the mirror is incompatible with a genuine three-cycle, so this file is also the disproof of any pure mirror recommendation.

cycles.note: 全員がドヒドイデを先発に置く3通り。裏の2枚と、先発のもう1枚だけが違う
